create.name: Elise Browning Miller
create.bio:
Elise Browning Miller is a senior certified Iyengar yoga teacher and certified yoga therapist who lives in Carmel, California. She has taught since 1976, has travelled to Pune since 1978 to learn from B. K. S. Iyengar and his family, and founded the California Yoga Center, where her public classes now run online. Before yoga became her work she took a master's degree in therapeutic recreation at the University of North Carolina.

Scoliosis shaped her own early practice, and much of her teaching is about working intelligently with the spine: careful alignment, props such as belts, ropes and the wall, and sequences adapted for people with curves or a tender back. She runs retreats and workshops in the United States and abroad, some for general practitioners and some aimed at students and yoga teachers interested in scoliosis and back care, and she sees private students over Zoom. She has written for Yoga Journal, co-wrote the book Yoga for Scoliosis: A Path for Students and Teachers with Nancy Heraty, wrote Yoga Anytime, Anywhere with Carol Blackman, and has made several practice videos, including a flowing Iyengar sequence filmed on a beach in Fiji.

courses.title: Sunsational Yoga Retreat in Mexico with Zoreh and Elise
courses.description: A week of yoga on Manzanilla Bay at Troncones on Mexico's Pacific coast, staying at Casa Manzanillo and Hacienda Edén. Practice is paired with quiet time and optional outings such as kayaking, hikes, birdwatching and whale watching.

courses.title: Yoga for Scoliosis and Backcare Retreat in Bahamas
courses.description: A four-day retreat for students with a curved or sensitive spine and for yoga teachers who want to support them. Participants learn to read their own pattern and practise adapted postures, traction and breath awareness for length, symmetry and comfort, while teachers study adjustments.

courses.title: Private yoga sessions with Elise (Zoom)
courses.description: One-to-one sessions, currently online only, in which Elise builds a personal home practice of poses around the student's body and needs. A first session lasts 90 minutes, with shorter follow-ups to refine the sequence.

courses.title: Iyengar Vinyasa DVD + online streaming
courses.description: A fifty-minute intermediate home practice filmed on a Fijian beach. It starts with sun salutations and Iyengar-style jumpings, then works through standing poses, backbends, inversions, balancing and twisting poses; shorter options are included for busy days.

courses.title: Yoga Anytime, Anywhere
courses.description: A step-by-step guide to simple yoga poses for easing stress and building vitality, written with Carol Blackman for people of every age and ability.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @elisebmilleryoga 1,840 subscribers (YouTube Data API, 12 Nov 2026); Facebook linked but not fetched -> ~2k -> local_hero
flags: Health restore: under the new rule yoga for scoliosis and back care is a practice routine naming a condition, so she is listed. The Bahamas retreat page promises 'practical solutions for improved alignment and pain relief' (pain relief through practice; kept with a neutral description); her home page says she specialises in scoliosis, back problems and sports injuries.
Her own site has been hacked: the Yoga Resources page (https://ebmyoga.com/yoga_resources/) carries injected casino and gambling spam. Not linked; the owner may want to tell her.
Iyengar lineage: she is a senior certified Iyengar teacher and founded California Yoga Center (Mountain View); the centre is not on Spiritpedia. Possible future hub listing.
Retreat prices are handled by the hosting venues, so both retreats are 'Contact for pricing'. The Mexico retreat is co-led with Zoreh (surname not given).
Photos: her own site's headshot (427 x 640) and her YouTube avatar (an older, softer image); same person.
Videos are short prop demonstrations (2-3.5 minutes) from 2012-2021; two under two minutes left out.
Base: Carmel, California (about page); availability set to worldwide as classes and privates are online only and retreats are abroad.
left_out: Yoga for Scoliosis and Back Care Retreat in Mexico (7-14 Nov 2026): already started.

Store items Yoga for Scoliosis DVD, booklet, combo, downloadable workshops, Yoga for Back Care booklet and the book Yoga for Scoliosis: A Path for Students & Teachers: condition-named practice materials, allowed under the new rule, but left out to keep the page from being mainly condition-titled; owner may add.
Yoga for Scoliosis t-shirt and yoga belt: merchandise.
Public classes: run online by California Yoga Center on its own site.
Videos 'Yoga for Back care and Scoliosis three part door knob pull' (2:00, at the two-minute floor) and 'How to buckle the Hugger Mugger cinch 10ft yoga belt' (0:55, product demo).
No books with ISBNs: her books are sold only through her own store (listed as an offering where kept).
